effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less. If this effect didn't delete, this Digimon gets +3000 DP for the turn.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] While you have 0 or less memory, add 2000 to this Digimon's DP-based deletion effects' maximums.
